description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper for a QR code scanner using the DataScannerViewController. It handles camera support checks, error reporting, and parsing scanned QR code data to trigger appropriate callbacks, including deep link processing.

classes.name: QRScannerView
classes.description: A SwiftUI wrapper that provides QR code scanning functionality, integrating with UIKit's DataScannerViewController and managing scan results and errors through callbacks.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: An internal delegate class conforming to DataScannerViewControllerDelegate, responsible for handling scan results, errors, and coordinating callbacks to the parent view.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController, checking device support and starting the scanner.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Updates the UIKit view controller if needed; intentionally left empty here.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops the scanner and triggers the onDismiss callback when the view is dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Instantiates the Coordinator object to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles reporting errors to the parent, ensuring errors are only reported once.

methods.name: dataScanner(_:didAdd:allItems:)
methods.description: Processes recognized QR code items, attempts to parse them as either setup codes or URLs, and invokes corresponding callbacks.

methods.name: dataScanner(_:didRemove:allItems:)
methods.description: Placeholder for handling item removal; currently does nothing.

methods.name: dataScanner(_:becameUnavailableWithError:)
methods.description: Handles scanner unavailability errors by notifying the parent.
